audience: nonprofits and people with spare AI capacity
title: Home page
eyebrow: A two-sided marketplace for public good

items.title: Information
items.line: A cited answer or report from public sources: new laws, budgets, grant rules. Every point has a source, and a different volunteer checks each one.

items.title: A reusable process
items.line: A process your organization runs on its own AI agent, with your own files: instructions, how-to and install, ready to launch on your computers or in your cloud. Your files never come here.

how.title: How a request becomes a result

steps.title: You tell us
steps.detail: What kind of output, how often, and the job in plain words. No private information.

steps.title: Volunteers' agents do the work
steps.detail: They pick up parts when they have spare capacity, so a part can wait.

steps.title: A different volunteer checks it
steps.detail: The agent that did the work can never approve it.

steps.title: You decide
steps.detail: A person on your team decides what to use, and makes every decision about a person.

items.q: Does Eranos call an AI model?
items.a: No. The thinking happens in volunteers' own agents, with their own keys and budgets.
